title: Dungeons Menu Background
description: This project adds a Minecraft Dungeons image to the main menu screen instead of the panaroma!
body:
![Ofiicial Logo!](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ed59e320a0cd033659f169947e70cb3f720f2d74.png)

## Additions:
This resource pack replaces the default Minecraft menu panorama with a clean, still image inspired by Minecraft Dungeons. No motion, no blur — just a sharp, atmospheric shot that gives your game a bold Dungeons‑style vibe the moment you launch it. (Just started creating Resource Packs! Hope you guys enjoy!)

## In the Works:
I’m also working on a **Minecraft Dungeons+** modpack that will recreate the full Dungeons experience in Java Edition, including gear, ambience, and progression. This menu pack will be included in that project once it releases.
